title: Tower Tumble
description: Pull blocks from a leaning tower and stack them on top — one wrong tug and it all comes down. Play free solo or take turns with your party.
author: Isaac
controls: Select a block, then drag along the arrow to pull it free. Drag the held block over the tower and press Place block to drop it. Lift your finger or mouse to pause safely. Drag empty space or right-drag to rotate; scroll to zoom. On touch, use two fingers to orbit and pinch to zoom.
